readiness_trigger.start_rule: Start as soon as all named inputs exist; no calendar date is a trigger. A comparison ready but not run is a defect.

execution_rule.order: Canonical repository order on first repetition, reverse on second, rotate first arm to last on third; same case order and fresh isolated stores
execution_rule.model: Preserve the native account and configured default model/effort; record exact identity in the freeze. No new paid route or model download is authorized by this artifact.
execution_rule.preflight: Record unsupported role, license/model conflicts, absent test recipes and failed installation as unqualified arms with the source-backed reason; never silently omit a survivor
execution_rule.cost: Record complete provider usage and elapsed time separately from tool-output/token estimates; never infer provider savings
execution_rule.protected_window: Heavy E2E during the CC's Monday window uses systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUWeight=idle; a full suite additionally needs SUITE-REQUEST and SUITE-GO.

fixed_decision_rule.eligibility: For each predeclared role, every mapped role check must pass in all three repetitions with complete usage and upstream E2E at the comparison's immutable source pin. Dependency arms qualify only their mapped interface and are never scored as standalone end-to-end candidates.
fixed_decision_rule.rank: For each role, maximize exact grounded-correct cases, then minimize total provider cost, then median elapsed time, then peak RSS. Compare only arms covering that same role; dependency components keep their own qualification receipts.
fixed_decision_rule.tie: Retain the existing qualified incumbent for that role if tied. Otherwise retain all exactly tied qualified arms with their measured equality; do not claim superiority.
fixed_decision_rule.none_qualify: Record RETIRED for the unsupported role with all failure/retirement reasons; do not promote an unqualified arm.
fixed_decision_rule.terminal: FINAL requires every selected deployed winner's actual final-stack runs[] pin to match its adopted tested source, with verdict/wave/next_review, upstream E2E at that operational run pin and invoke evidence/role reason. An experimental source-pin receipt does not qualify a different historical operational run pin.
fixed_decision_rule.amendments: No new candidates or changed metrics after first run. Any necessary input correction requires a separately reviewed, hashed amendment before affected scoring.

role_assignment_rule: role_ids, dependency and role_checks are frozen here; identical singleton case sets or unions of competing roles cannot create a separate ranking. Source-advertised roles enter the common requirement comparison. No assignment or applicability change at execution/scoring time.

role_reconciliation.requirement_basis: The layer requires semantic retrieval over the same project corpus. The associative arm cases 0-4 equal semantic_code_retrieval plus project_semantic_index. Association is an implementation mechanism, not a separately selected role.

role_reconciliation.qualification_boundary: Role applicability is a preregistered comparison obligation, not a claim that this arm passed the common oracle or supports every required operation.
